analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), motion sheet, audio panel and listen sheet (5 accent hits at -0.1/0/+0.1 s); strips 0.00-2.70 s (10 fps), 4.95-6.45 s (20 fps) and 11.70-12.80 s (30 fps). No transitions sheet exists (0 boundaries detected). automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s; the strike, the scramble and the reveal at frame level; every accent checked against its frame.

concept.observed: A teaser on a near-black warm canvas: a rim light traces a large letter mark, a line states an old meaning, an 'equals' statement is struck through and scrambled into a question mark, the mark shatters, one post card multiplies into a wall, the wall dissolves into small mark-shaped particles that spiral into a point, and after half a second of silence the product name lands with a tagline and a closing word.
concept.interpreted: Tease by negation: show the old meaning, cross it out, ask, then reveal. The mystery comes from darkness, slowness and one silence.

communication_style.observed: Short centred lines in a clean sans, one italic serif word for the question and the closing word; no voice.

palette.observed: Near-black warm brown (#080808, 84% of sampled pixels) with ember-orange highlights and white type; mean luma 0.05.

typography.observed: Clean sans for statements; italic serif for the question mark and the closing word; small grey subtitle line.

motion.observed: Slow light sweeps (0-2.6 s); glyph scramble (5.20-5.90 s); shatter (7.45-7.65 s); one card becomes a wall (7.9-10.1 s); particles swirl inward (11.70-11.87 s).

transitions.observed: No hard cut (the analyser found 0 boundaries); every change happens in place on the dark stage. 0.0-2.6 s a rim light travels along the mark's edges until its silhouette reads (continuous). 2.6-4.1 s the subtitle and the statement fade up (continuous). 5.00-6.35 s a strike line crosses the second word, the word scrambles to nothing and a question mark fades in (continuous). 7.45-7.65 s the mark shatters (continuous). 7.9-10.1 s one card becomes a wall (continuous). 10.14-10.24 s the wall dissolves into particles (cover by particles). 11.70-11.87 s the particles spiral into one point (grow, reversed). 12.47-12.57 s a warm two-frame bloom releases the lockup (grow).
transitions.interpreted: A teaser can run without a cut: darkness lets each element appear and leave in place, and the one transition with weight is the implode-then-bloom at the reveal.

texture_and_effects.observed: Glow, ember light leaks, soft depth of field on the card wall.

sound_design.observed: -14.3 LUFS, LRA 8.7 LU, true peak -1.3 dBTP; tempo estimate 78 bpm (low confidence); 5 accents (20/min) at 0.26 s (first light), 5.06 s (strike), 6.32 s (question mark lands), 7.55 s (shatter) and 12.56 s (lockup); no picture boundaries to compare (chance 0.06). The level falls about 25 dB from 6.9 s and returns on the shatter at 7.55 s; full silence 12.00-12.54 s, then the lockup hit at 12.56 s; head 5.3 dB and tail 3.7 dB below the body. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Every accent marks a change of meaning (crossed out, questioned, broken, revealed), and the two biggest are prepared by taking sound away first.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 0 words (13 raw words below the confidence cut) over music; the listen frames show no speaker and no captions.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: None; copy is centred statements with a smaller subtitle line under them and a centred end stack (name, line, closing word).

scenes.observed: A rim light traces a large letter mark in the dark.
A subtitle states the old meaning; an 'equals' statement.
The second word is struck, scrambled away and replaced by a question mark.
One post card multiplies into a wall of cards.
The wall dissolves into mark-shaped particles that swirl into a point.
A tiny mark holds in silence.
Bloom; product name, tagline and a closing word.

moments.observed: After 0.54 s of silence (12.00-12.54 s) a warm bloom fills the frame for two frames and the product name appears with the hit at 12.56 s.
moments.interpreted: Silence plus a bloom makes a quiet film's biggest moment without loudness.

moments.observed: A red line strikes the second word of the statement in 0.1 s; the struck word cycles through random glyphs for 0.7 s and fades; a question mark takes its place at 6.20-6.35 s.
